say:1:1710408001:1.text: I've been expecting you. Any news about Peggy?
say:1:1710408001:1.source_cn: 梅林，罗万，我一直在等待你们到来。有关于佩吉的线索了吗？
say:1:1710408001:1.male: I've been expecting you. Any news about Peggy?
say:1:1710408001:1.female: I've been expecting you. Any news about Peggy?

say:2:1710408002:1.text: What?! I thought Peggy was here!
say:2:1710408002:1.source_cn: 什么？佩吉她真的没有回来吗？！我还以为她和我一样，只是...
say:2:1710408002:1.male: What?! I thought Peggy was here!
say:2:1710408002:1.female: What?! I thought Peggy was here!

say:3:1710408003:1.text: Hmm... looks like the worst has happened.
say:3:1710408003:1.source_cn: 果然如此……看来最坏的情况发生了。
say:3:1710408003:1.male: Hmm... looks like the worst has happened.
say:3:1710408003:1.female: Hmm... looks like the worst has happened.

say:4:1710408004:1.text: Rowan, I need you to stay calm and tell me everything that happened inside the Hall of Ancients. Leave nothing out.
say:4:1710408004:1.source_cn: 罗万，冷静。把圣古堂消失后，里面发生的一切，事无巨细地...
say:4:1710408004:1.male: Rowan, I need you to stay calm and tell me everything that happened inside the Hall of Ancients. Leave nothing out.
say:4:1710408004:1.female: Rowan, I need you to stay calm and tell me everything that happened inside the Hall of Ancients. Leave nothing out.

say:5:1710408005:1.text: To be honest, I'm still trying to make sense of it all...
say:5:1710408005:1.source_cn: 该怎么说起呢……我自己也是一头雾水……
say:5:1710408005:1.male: To be honest, I'm still trying to make sense of it all...
say:5:1710408005:1.female: To be honest, I'm still trying to make sense of it all...

say:6:1710408006:1.text: ... It was absolute chaos inside. Hypofiends attacked us, and Hendrik and Cassadee did their best to hold them back... Then, Peggy...
say:6:1710408006:1.source_cn: ……当时情况很乱。我们在里面遇到了魔物的袭击，亨德里克...

say:7:1710408007:1.text: Rowan goes over everything in detail, including Peggy's unsuccessful attempt to pull Excalibur, and how it then moved by itself.
say:7:1710408007:1.source_cn: 罗万将佩吉试图拔剑失败，随后石中剑“显灵”的经过如实汇...

say:8:1710408008:1.text: I'm pleased that Peggy took the initiative to confront the danger.
say:8:1710408008:1.source_cn: 佩吉这孩子，在魔物危及臣民性命的绝境下，她果然没有坐以待毙。

say:9:1710408009:1.text: But... everyone else is back... Why are Peggy and Cassadee still trapped?
say:9:1710408009:1.source_cn: 只是……失踪的人都归来了，为何唯独佩吉和科丝蒂没有……

say:10:1710408010:1.text: I-I don't understand! How come only the two of them were left behind?
say:10:1710408010:1.source_cn: 这、这到底是怎么回事？为什么只有她们两个被留下了？

say:11:1710408011:1.text: Right now, everyone's spreading rumors about the incident... I've even heard unpleasant things about you, Your Majesty!
say:11:1710408011:1.source_cn: 现在外面那些贵族和民众都在乱说……甚至连您也被牵扯进去了！

say:12:1710408012:1.text: Rumors? Hmm, the tide of public sentiment seems to be turning against me...
say:12:1710408012:1.source_cn: 流言吗？这就对了。仅仅是刚才发生的事，舆论的风向就已经...

say:13:1710408013:1.text: It's a shame that the ruler's legitimacy is now being called into question. I suspect someone's deliberately pushing the narrative...
say:13:1710408013:1.source_cn: 甚至上升到了质疑王室合法性的高度。这背后或许不止是民众...

say:14:1710408014:1.text: Rowan, this is where you come in. Members of the Mithril Consortium roam every street and alley of Savannah, and they are far more adept than the Royal Guard at gathering intelligence.
say:14:1710408014:1.source_cn: 罗万，这正是我需要你去做的事。秘银商会的成员们遍布赛凡...

say:15:1710408015:1.text: I need you to look into these rumors and trace them back to their origin. It might lead to something important.
say:15:1710408015:1.source_cn: 我需要你去追踪这些流言，去查清楚这些消息的源头指向哪里...

say:16:1710408016:1.text: I see. Someone's trying to spread panic among the public to further their own ends.
say:16:1710408016:1.source_cn: 我明白了！有人在利用这件事制造恐慌，想要达成某种目的。

say:17:1710408017:0.text: I'll take care of it, Your Majesty!
